notes.title: Futurtech Studio's eighth video game is on the way!
notes.content:
It's called "Pago Forest Adventure"! As the name suggests, it's an action-adventure game set in the fantasy world of "Pago Forest".
Battles, traps, puzzles and discoveries await you in 2024, coded on the latest version of Unreal Engine 5!
All objects such as jars, barrels, tables, chairs, buckets, lampposts, etc. will be destructible in the game, powered by UE5's Chaos Destuction! Bosses will have evolving AIs and will give you a hard time, but don't worry! Three difficulty modes are available for young and old alike! Suffice to say, this will be one of the Studio's must-haves!
 Find out more about the game on twitter, facebook and instagram here: [url=linktr.ee/futurtechstudio]linktr.ee/futurtechstudio[/url]

notes.title: A new major update is available!
notes.content:
Following the crashes of the game due to the release of the Intel generation 10 and 11 processors which were incompatible with the "Unreal Engine 4.19" which remains too old, an update was necessary.
LA FORET DE PAGO LA VENGEANCE DU DRAGON is now available in Unreal Engine 4.24 which solves this incompatibility problem, but we took this opportunity to make some improvements.
The changes are:

-Better performance in game thanks to a graphical optimization
-Problems with some buttons have been fixed by reworking the coding
-Waiting times for some sentences have been shortened
-Compatibility with the latest graphics cards and processors

notes.title: Une nouvelle mise à jour majeure est disponible !
notes.content:
Suite aux crashs du jeu à cause de la sortie des processeurs Intel génération 10 et 11 qui était incompatible avec le moteur "Unreal Engine 4.19" qui demeure trop vieillissant, une mise à jour s'imposait.
LA FORET DE PAGO LA VENGEANCE DU DRAGON est maintenant disponible en version 4.24 d'Unreal Engine ce qui règle ce problème d'incompatibilité, mais nous avons profité de cette occasion pour apporter quelques améliorations.
Les modifications sont :

-De meilleures performances en jeu grâce à une optimisation graphique
-Des problèmes sur certains boutons ont été réglés grâce à un remaniement du codage
-Les temps d'attentes de certaines phrases ont été écourtées
-Une compatibilité avec les dernières cartes graphiques et processeurs

notes.title: Une nouvelle mise à jour majeure est disponible !
notes.content:
Le premier volet de la trilogie : " LA FORET DE PAGO : LA VENGEANCE DU DRAGON " a été mis à jour aujourd'hui
pour le plaisir des fans de jeux éducatifs et de l'univers fantastique de Pago.

- La Vengeance du Dragon a enfin droit à de nombreux succès Steam et à un tableau des scores.
- L'interface, les menus et les encadrés sont améliorés et optimisés.
- Le lexique est étendu.
- Le temps de chargement entre les phrases et propositions est divisé par deux.
- Les phrases complexes et alambiquées liées à l'obligation d'utiliser le présent de l'indicatif dans ce premier volet sont modifiées pour une meilleure compréhension.
- Le menu principal fait peau neuve avec de nouvelles fonctionnalités et un dragon plus réaliste.
- La fin du générique a été modifié.
- Le tutoriel est plus clair et dispose de nouvelles informations.
- Des liens internet externes sont disponibles dans le menu principal et à la fin du générique.
- Le volume sonore est maintenant réglable dans les menus.

D'autres contenus seront ajoutés par la suite si le projet est suffisamment soutenu.
Nous manquons d'évaluations de joueurs sur Steam alors nous comptons sur votre soutien:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413590/LA_FORET_DE_PAGO__LA_VENGEANCE_DU_DRAGON

notes.title: Our strategy game is on special offer right now!
notes.content:
Take advantage of the moment to work your brain with PAGO FOREST TOWER DEFENSE

The goal of the game is to put the defenses at the right time and place against the enemies. For this, you will need gold! A lot of gold! And courage of course...
The game is composed of 5 acts, 26 missions that each have their own cinematic. Each act ends with a boss.
We will also find a mana bar for the spells delivered by the artifacts (be careful, some powers are only used once per level).
The game is simple to understand but you will have to be strategic to finish it...

Summary of the story: 
Flora, former leader of the Nova army, is back. 
Still alive, Baal the necromancer, contaminates the lands of Pago with his evil powers. 
Flora's mission is to build a great army and recover the artifacts of power to destroy her enemies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425270/PAGO_FOREST_TOWER_DEFENSE

notes.title: Pre-order " La Forêt de Pago 2 : Souvenir de Glace " on kickstarter!
notes.content:
La Forêt de Pago is an educational video game that allows you to improve your spelling through a fantastic tale.
On the occasion of the release of the second part of our trilogy, get access to many gifts (game pack, T-shirt, poster, mug, laser lamp...) by choosing the formula of your choice. At the same time, you will encourage the RILE of Carpentras, an association that helps young entrepreneurs, since all the profits collected will be transferred to it.
Thank you all for your participation.  

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/la-foret-de-pago/la-foret-de-pago-souvenir-de-glace]Kickstarter[/url]

notes.title: "PAGO FOREST: ICE REMEMBRANCE" (French Version)
notes.content:
We are at 70% of the main campaign.

We decided to add bonus vocabulary and spelling games around the central scenario.

The game will be released in "early access" on Steam in late March/early April. You will then have access to the full main campaign and the mini-games will be available as free updates as they are developed.

This second part of our trilogy will bring significant improvements: the help boxes are more digestible but you will be able to learn more thanks to a new tab, the grammar one, which can be consulted at any time in the story, as is the case for the lexicon.

Many of you bought the first part of our game, Pago Forest: The Dragon's Revenge. Feel free to write a review on Steam to support us. 

[url=https://www.la-foret-de-pago.fr/la-foret-de-pago-2/]WEBSITE[/url]
